metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Vietnam between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - FIRMS collection: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MCD14ML" (near real-time) - Better to use "FIRMS" which is "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily fire product) - Date range: August 2016 to February 2018 - Location: Country boundaries for Cambodia and Vietnam 2. Masking strategy: - This is about fire detections, so we need to count fire pixels - Use the confidence band to filter for high-confidence fires - No cloud masking needed for fire products 3. Logic: - Count total fire detections in each country - Compare Cambodia vs Vietnam - Valid zero (B) if Vietnam has more or equal fires - A if Cambodia has more - C1 if no data found - C2 if valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3 if calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017'); const cambodia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')).geometry(); const vietnam = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Vietnam')).geometry(); const startDate = '2016-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-02-28'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Fire Product let fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD14ML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total fire collection size: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No fire data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire detections for each country // MCD14ML has MaxFRP band - we'll count pixels with fire detections const fireImage = fireCol.select(['MaxFRP']).max(); // Get maximum FRP across all dates // Count fire pixels in Cambodia const cambodiaStats = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cambodiaCount = cambodiaStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); // Count fire pixels in Vietnam const vietnamStats = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vietnam, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const vietnamCount = vietnamStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); console.log(`Cambodia fire detections: ${cambodiaCount}`); console.log(`Vietnam fire detections: ${vietnamCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (cambodiaCount === null || vietnamCount === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values returned."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (cambodiaCount === 0 && vietnamCount === 0) { console.log("No valid fire pixels detected in either country."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Compare and answer if (cambodiaCount > vietnamCount) { console.log("Cambodia had MORE active fire detections than Vietnam."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Cambodia did NOT have more active fire detections than Vietnam."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
